2025 p. 1generally, a cfc is any foreign corporation if more than 50% of its voting power or stock value is owned or considered owned by u.s. shareholders (as defined in section 951(b)) on any day during the tax year.2026 p. 2generally, a cfc is a foreign corporation if u.s. shareholders (as defined in section 951(b)) own or are considered to own more than 50% of its voting power or stock value on any day during the tax year.
